## What
A few sentences. One idea per PR.

## Why
What this unblocks for contributors or users.

## Test plan
- [ ] `cd server && npm test`
- [ ] Tested locally (extension reload + a real GitHub PR, or curl for API-only)
- [ ] UI change: before/after screenshot or a short clip
- [ ] Roast/archetype/GIF change: linked a public PR + pasted the roast I got

## House rules
- [ ] No `.env`, keys, or secrets
- [ ] Roast the code, not the person
- [ ] Did not add `localhost` to the shipped `manifest.json` unless this PR is `manifest.dev.json` only
